messages.subject: Comparison of theta: mirt versus probit
parts:
Hi Phill,

I am trying to compare the theta (ability) obtained from mirt and from a normal ogive model. Do I have to divide theta by 1.702 and multiply it by -1 as well?

Thank you,

Juliane

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Comparison of theta: mirt versus probit
parts:
Hi Juliane,

For latent trait estimates, provided that the models have been fit to the same data then no you don't have to transform the scores. Transformation is only required for item parameters. Cheers.

Phil
